_description: E-043: the f4r2-40M configuration (512x12, 4 heads, d_dec 256, d_z 32, patch 1, pentad r2 tensor with SST as channel 40) with NO LONGITUDE HOLDOUT. Differs from f4r2-40M.json in exactly one field, holdout_lon '0,0', so the -45..-25 block trains instead of being withheld. This is the new PENTAD BASELINE: it folds together the two changes that were each pending separately — SST as an input channel, and the corrected holdout regime — because both are now the intended default and running them one at a time costs a box-day each to answer questions we have already decided. WHY '0,0' AND NOT 'none': [0,0) is the empty half-open interval, so the mask is bit-identical to what 'none' produces, but twelve eval scripts under ml/ still re-read ck['args']['holdout_lon'] with float() and would lose the entire probe ladder to a ValueError swallowed by a best-effort guard — a green run with an empty probe archive. See f3-anchor-41M-nolonhold.json for the full list and the follow-up that makes 'none' safe. DISPATCH WITH `resume` EMPTY: this is a fresh codec, the 39-channel anchor cannot encode a 40-channel tensor, and a recipe cannot pin resume (the seed step reads inputs.resume in an `if:`, a YAML expression context $RECIPE_RESUME cannot reach). FAMILY-4 WORK GOES ON 126 GB BOXES ONLY (#368 host-OOMed on a 63 GB box). HEAD_PROBE IS 'true' HERE EXPLICITLY (2026-08-21). The workflow's default is now true as well, so this key changes nothing about what runs — it states it, because a recipe is the record of a configuration that was RUN and 'which read-out produced the verdict' is now part of that configuration. ml/CLAUDE.md §3: unpooled is the verdict, the pooled ridge is a labelled legacy comparable, and both sides of a comparison switch together (the head's raw-3x3 and wind-only bars are fitted in the same loop, scripts/probes_run.sh).
_provenance: Architecture copied field-for-field from ml/recipes/f4r2-40M.json, which took it from f4-40M and differs only in the tensor; params 37,976,465 (+576 over #386's r1 arm: chan_emb +512 and q_chan +64, one row each for channel 40). The holdout change is Chris's decision of 2026-08-19: the per-pixel anomaly transform already removes location-memorised climatology, the block costs 25% of the training pixels, and it confounds the spatial-coupling claim because about half the stencil head's measured advantage is earned patching the hole in its own coords=(lat/90, lon/180) feature. The SST half carries one measurement, from cancelled #411 (E-042 SST arm, killed at step 107,000/200,000 when this regime change was decided): against its matched r1 control #386 on the 14 shared full-probe steps, linear_r_deseas 0.6325 vs 0.6079 (+0.0246), linear_r_raw +0.0345, temporal_r_deseas +0.0050, z_vs_persistence -1.41pp. Suggestive at one seed and not decisive — SST's own verdict is deferred to this run's head + raw-3x3 pair, which per ml/CLAUDE.md section 3 is the read-out we trust at pentad cadence. NOTHING HAS BEEN RUN AT THIS CONFIGURATION YET; this recipe is the dispatch surface, and its _provenance becomes a measurement when the run lands.
